summary.content:
Today's selection covers 88 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Mark Zuckerberg Blasts Centralization of A.I. Power
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Police Say Binance Is Making It Harder to Fight Crime
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, Ars Technica, Dark Reading, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 50 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: Mark Zuckerberg Blasts Centralization of A.I. Power
top.description: In an interview with The Times, Meta’s chief executive took aim at Anthropic and OpenAI, which have pushed to tightly control A.I. development, and said he supported “more openness.”

top.title: When AI Agents Escape Sandboxes, Old Security Rules Apply
top.description: OpenAI's recent AI agent sandbox escape proves traditional security principles matter more than ever: limit access, isolate execution, log everything.
